newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean, corn basis down.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean, corn basis down.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean and corn values continued lower in reaction to light export demand for old-crop supplies, grain dealers said.
Taiwan bought 54,000 tonnes of U.S. corn late Wednesday for August-September shipment.

Winter wheat values were mostly unchanged. The soft red winter and hard red winter wheat harvests were under way and should continue through the weekend, dealers said. Both crops were producing good yields and quality, dealers said.
